For tree : Tree (Real × Real), define exactProductTree tree := tree.map (fun p => p.1 * p.2), roundedProductTree model tree := tree.map (fun p => model.mul p.1 p.2), and roundedDotProduct model tree := roundedSum model (roundedProductTree model tree). Thus each multiplication is rounded once and every internal tree addition is rounded once. Establish leaf/node unfolding equations as needed; Tree.depth_map preserves the reduction depth.

Plan a lemma for arbitrary model : Model, k : Nat, and tree : Tree (Real × Real): if tree.depth <= k and ((k+1 : Nat) : Real) * model.u < 1, there exists perturbed : Tree Real with IsPerturbation (gamma (k+1) model.u) (exactProductTree tree) perturbed and perturbed.exactSum = roundedDotProduct model tree. The original and witness must have matching leaf positions, including repeated product values.

At every leaf (a,b), use model.round_spec (a*b) to obtain a multiplication error delta with abs delta <= model.u and rounded product = (a*b)*(1+delta). Construct the witness leaf with that rounded product and bound its absolute change by model.u * abs (a*b), without division by a*b. Use gamma_step at 0 and gamma_zero to bound model.u by gamma 1 model.u. For a leaf encountered with a larger depth budget k+1, gamma_step at k and gamma_nonneg imply model.u <= gamma (k+1) model.u; obtain the smaller-budget smallness hypotheses from model.u_nonneg. This also covers zero products and u=0.

Induct on k, generalizing tree. At k=0 the depth constraint excludes nodes. For a node in the successor case, Tree.depth = 1 + max left.depth right.depth implies each child has depth <= k. Derive ((k+1 : Nat) : Real) * model.u < 1 from the parent condition ((k+2 : Nat) : Real) * model.u < 1 using model.u_nonneg, then obtain both child witnesses with bound gamma (k+1) model.u. Handle Nat-to-Real casts explicitly.

For an internal node, apply model.round_spec to the sum of the two rounded child dot products to choose an addition error delta. Scale each child witness by (1+delta), and join them with Tree.node. Apply each child perturbation relation through IsPerturbation.scale_one_add, taking bound = gamma (k+1) model.u and nextBound = gamma (k+2) model.u. The required scalar bound is exactly gamma_step (k+1) model.u under the parent smallness condition. This incorporates the same node rounding into every leaf below that node.

Show that the constructed node witness has exact sum equal to the rounded dot product by Tree.exactSum_node, Tree.exactSum_scale, the child exact-sum equalities, and the addition round_spec equality. Use real distributivity and commutativity to reconcile factor orientation. Keep the perturbation relation anchored to exactProductTree, not to roundedProductTree alone.

Specialize the generalized witness lemma at k = tree.depth. The final theorem must quantify over every supplied abstract Model and every Tree (Real × Real), assume only ((tree.depth+1 : Nat) : Real) * model.u < 1 in addition to Model fields, and conclude existence of perturbed with IsPerturbation (gamma (tree.depth+1) model.u) (exactProductTree tree) perturbed and perturbed.exactSum = roundedDotProduct model tree. Do not replace this with an addition-only theorem, an exact-arithmetic special case, or an assumption asserting the desired witness.
